ezekiel.6.p1.b1.text: “Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

ezekiel.6.p1.b2.text: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD! … I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

ezekiel.6.p1.b3.text: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed;

ezekiel.6.p1.b4.text: Wherever you live, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be demolished, …

ezekiel.6.p1.b5.text: Then in the nations to which they have been carried captive, your survivors will remember Me— … So they will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their abominations.

ezekiel.6.p1.b6.text: Clap your hands, stomp your feet, and cry out

ezekiel.6.p1.b7.text: “Alas!” because of all the wicked abominations of the house of Israel, who will fall by sword and famine and plague.

ezekiel.6.p1.b8.text: Then you will know that I am the LORD, … on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, and under every green tree and leafy oak
